why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಶೋರೂಮ್‌ನವರು ರಿಪೇರಿ ಅಥವಾ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿ ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿದರು. ಜುಲೈ 4, 2025 ರಂದು ವಾರಂಟಿ ಇರುವಾಗಲೇ ಅದು ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡೋದು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿತು. ಬಹುಶಃ ಸರ್ವಿಸ್ ರಿಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಇದು ಮ್ಯಾನುಫ್ಯಾಕ್ಚರಿಂಗ್ ದೋಷ.
conditions: ನೀವು ಅದನ್ನು ಸ್ವಂತ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾ, ಎಷ್ಟು ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿರಿ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

ಸರ್ವಿಸ್ ಸೆಂಟರ್‌ನವರು ಚೆಕ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರಾ? ಮ್ಯಾನುಫ್ಯಾಕ್ಚರಿಂಗ್ ದೋಷ ಅಂದ್ರಾ ಅಥವಾ ಡ್ಯಾಮೇಜ್ ಅಂದ್ರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ರಿಪೇರಿ ಅಥವಾ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿ ಕೊಡಿ ಅಂತ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರಿಗೆ ಕೇಳಿದ್ರಾ? ಅವರು ಏನು ಹೇಳಿದರು? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

conditions: ನೀವು ಅದನ್ನು ಸ್ವಂತ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾ, ಎಷ್ಟು ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿರಿ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

conditions: ನೀವು ಅದನ್ನು ಸ್ವಂತ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾ, ಎಷ್ಟು ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿರಿ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

conditions: ನೀವು ಅದನ್ನು ಸ್ವಂತ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾ, ಎಷ್ಟು ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿರಿ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ವಸ್ತುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ಏನು ತೊಂದರೆ, ಯಾವಾಗಿಂದ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಸರ್ವಿಸ್ ಸೆಂಟರ್‌ನವರು ಚೆಕ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರಾ? ಮ್ಯಾನುಫ್ಯಾಕ್ಚರಿಂಗ್ ದೋಷ ಅಂದ್ರಾ ಅಥವಾ ಡ್ಯಾಮೇಜ್ ಅಂದ್ರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ರಿಪೇರಿ ಅಥವಾ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿ ಕೊಡಿ ಅಂತ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರಿಗೆ ಕೇಳಿದ್ರಾ? ಅವರು ಏನು ಹೇಳಿದರು? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
where_to_verify: Consumer Protection Act (2019) ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 2(7) ರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಠ್ಯವನ್ನು ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ (indiacode.nic.in) ಓದಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಉಚಿತ ಕಾನೂನು ನೆರವಿಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾನೂನು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆ ಅಲ್ಲ.

what_it_says:

(1) “advertisement” means any audio or visual publicity, representation, endorsement or 
pronouncement made by means of light, sound, smoke, gas, print, electronic media, internet or 
website and includes any notice, circular, label, wrapper, invoice or such other documents; 
(2) “appropriate laboratory” means a laboratory or an organisation— 
(i) recognised by the Central Government; or 
(ii) recognised by a State Government, subject to such guidelines as may be issued by the 
Central Government in this behalf; or 
(iii) established by or …
what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: अपने इस्तेमाल के लिए खरीदे सामान में खराबी है और विक्रेता या निर्माता मरम्मत, बदलाव या पैसे वापस नहीं कर रहा।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: 13 मई 2025 को वारंटी के अंदर ही वो पूरी तरह बंद हो गया। सर्विस रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक यह मैन्युफ़ैक्चरिंग की खराबी है। शोरूम वालों ने उसे ठीक करने या बदलने से मना कर दिया।
conditions: क्या आपने इसे अपने इस्तेमाल के लिए खरीदा था, और कितने पैसे दिए? — अभी पता नहीं
सामान में ठीक-ठीक क्या खराबी है और कब से? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या सर्विस सेंटर ने जाँच की? उन्होंने मैन्युफ़ैक्चरिंग खराबी बताई या नुकसान? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या आपने विक्रेता से मरम्मत या बदलने को कहा? उन्होंने क्या कहा? — आपने हाँ कहा
where_to_verify: Consumer Protection Act (2019) की धारा 2(7) का आधिकारिक पाठ इंडिया कोड (indiacode.nic.in) पर पढ़ें, या मुफ़्त कानूनी सहायता के लिए ज़िला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण से संपर्क करें। यह कानूनी सलाह नहीं है।

conditions: ಈ ಸೇವೆಗೆ ನೀವು ಹಣ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ಯಾವ ಪ್ಲಾನ್, ಎಷ್ಟು? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಪ್ಲಾನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಗದಿತ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ರಿಪೇರಿ ತರಹ ಏನಾದರೂ ಭರವಸೆ ಇತ್ತಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಸೇವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ಏನು ತೊಂದರೆ ಆಯಿತು, ಯಾವಾಗಿಂದ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಕಂಪ್ಲೇಂಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ಟಿಕೆಟ್ ನಂಬರ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟರಾ ಅಥವಾ ಸರಿ ಮಾಡಿದರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
where_to_verify: Consumer Protection Act (2019) ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 35 ರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಠ್ಯವನ್ನು ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ (indiacode.nic.in) ಓದಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಉಚಿತ ಕಾನೂನು ನೆರವಿಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾನೂನು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆ ಅಲ್ಲ.

why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: 16 सितंबर 2025 को कनेक्शन बंद हो गया और तीन हफ़्ते से बंद पड़ा है। मैंने कई बार शिकायत की, लेकिन कंपनी ने कुछ नहीं किया। मैंने प्रीमियम प्लान के लिए पहले से पंद्रह हज़ार रुपये जमा किए हैं। प्लान में लिखा था कि कोई भी खराबी 48 घंटे में ठीक की जाएगी।
conditions: क्या आपने इस सेवा के पैसे दिए? कौन सा प्लान, कितने? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या प्लान में तय समय में मरम्मत जैसा कोई वादा था? — आपने हाँ कहा
सेवा में ठीक-ठीक क्या गड़बड़ हुई और कब से? — अभी पता नहीं
क्या आपने कंपनी से शिकायत की? क्या टिकट नंबर दिया या ठीक किया? — आपने हाँ कहा
where_to_verify: Consumer Protection Act (2019) की धारा 35 का आधिकारिक पाठ इंडिया कोड (indiacode.nic.in) पर पढ़ें, या मुफ़्त कानूनी सहायता के लिए ज़िला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण से संपर्क करें। यह कानूनी सलाह नहीं है।

what_it_says:
(1) The District Commission, the State Commission or the National 
Commission shall not admit a complaint unless it is filed within two years from the date on which the 
cause of action has arisen. 
(2) Notwithstanding anything contained in sub -section (1), a complaint may be entertained after the 
period specified in sub -section ( 1), if the complainant satisfies the District Commission, the State 
Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, that he had sufficient cause for not filing 
the complaint within such period: 
Provided that no such complaint shall be entertained …
what_it_means: In simple words: You paid for a service, but its quality or performance fell short of what was promised or required.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: On 16 September 2025 the connection stopped working, and it has been dead for three weeks. I complained many times, but the company did nothing. I paid fifteen thousand rupees in advance for the premium plan. The plan promised that any fault would be fixed within 48 hours.
conditions: Did you pay for this service? Which plan, and how much? — you said yes
Did the plan promise anything specific, such as repair within a fixed time? — you said yes
What exactly went wrong with the service, and since when? — not known yet
Have you complained to the company? Did they give a ticket number or fix it? — you said yes

what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ನೀವು ಹಣ ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಸೇವೆಯ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ಅಥವಾ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಭರವಸೆ ನೀಡಿದ್ದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇದೆ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಮೇ 20, 2025 ರಂದು ಕನೆಕ್ಷನ್ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡೋದು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿತು, ಮೂರು ವಾರದಿಂದ ಬಂದ್ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಪ್ಲಾನ್‌ಗೆ ನಾನು ಮುಂಚಿತವಾಗಿ 5,000 ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೀನಿ. ಯಾವುದೇ ತೊಂದರೆ 48 ಗಂಟೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಸರಿ ಮಾಡ್ತೀವಿ ಅಂತ ಪ್ಲಾನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದರು.

what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ತನ್ನದೇ ರಿಟರ್ನ್ ನೀತಿ ಇದ್ದರೂ ವಾಪಸ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟ ವಸ್ತುವಿಗೆ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರು ಹಣ ವಾಪಸ್ ಕೊಡ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಆದರೆ ಆಪ್‌ನವರು ದುಡ್ಡು ವಾಪಸ್ ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿದರು. ಏಳು ದಿನದೊಳಗೆ ವಾಪಸ್ ಕೊಡಬಹುದು ಅಂತ ಪ್ರಾಡಕ್ಟ್ ಪೇಜ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಿತ್ತು. ಬಹುಶಃ ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಮಾಡುವಾಗಲೇ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಐವತ್ತು ಸಾವಿರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೆ.
conditions: ನೀವು ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ರಾ, ಅಥವಾ ಕ್ಯಾಶ್ ಆನ್ ಡೆಲಿವರಿನಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಪ್ರಾಡಕ್ಟ್ ಪೇಜ್ ಅಥವಾ ಪಾಲಿಸಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಪಸ್ ಕೊಡಬಹುದು ಅಂತ ಇತ್ತಾ? ಎಷ್ಟು ದಿನದೊಳಗೆ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ನೀವು ವಸ್ತು ವಾಪಸ್ ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ರಾ? ಯಾವಾಗ ಪಿಕಪ್ ಆಯ್ತು? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever, by words either spoken or intended to be read, or by signs or by 
visible representations, makes or publishes in any manner, any imputation concerning any person 
intending to harm, or knowing or having reason to believe that such imputation will harm, the reputation 
of such person, is said, except in the cases hereinafter excepted, to defame that person. 
Explanation 1.—It may amount to defamation to impute anything to a deceased person, if the 
imputation would harm the reputation of that person if living, and is intended to be hurtful to the feelings 
of his family or other …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever, by words either spoken or intended to be read, or by signs or by 
visible representations, makes or publishes in any manner, any imputation concerning any person 
intending to harm, or knowing or having reason to believe that such imputation will harm, the reputation 
of such person, is said, except in the cases hereinafter excepted, to defame that person. 
Explanation 1.—It may amount to defamation to impute anything to a deceased person, if the 
imputation would harm the reputation of that person if living, and is intended to be hurtful to the feelings 
of his family or other …

(1) Whoever, by words either spoken or intended to be read, or by signs or by 
visible representations, makes or publishes in any manner, any imputation concerning any person 
intending to harm, or knowing or having reason to believe that such imputation will harm, the reputation 
of such person, is said, except in the cases hereinafter excepted, to defame that person. 
Explanation 1.—It may amount to defamation to impute anything to a deceased person, if the 
imputation would harm the reputation of that person if living, and is intended to be hurtful to the feelings 
of his family or other …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …

person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally

(1) Whoever, by words either spoken or intended to be read, or by signs or by 
visible representations, makes or publishes in any manner, any imputation concerning any person 
intending to harm, or knowing or having reason to believe that such imputation will harm, the reputation

imputation would harm the reputation of that person if living, and is intended to be hurtful to the feelings 
of his family or other …

visible representations, makes or publishes in any manner, any imputation concerning any person 
intending to harm, or knowing or having reason to believe that such imputation will harm, the reputation 
of such person, is said, except in the cases hereinafter excepted, to defame that person.

imputation would harm the reputation of that person if living, and is intended to be hurtful to the feelings 
of his family or other …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever, by words either spoken or intended to be read, or by signs or by 
visible representations, makes or publishes in any manner, any imputation concerning any person 
intending to harm, or knowing or having reason to believe that such imputation will harm, the reputation 
of such person, is said, except in the cases hereinafter excepted, to defame that person. 
Explanation 1.—It may amount to defamation to impute anything to a deceased person, if the 
imputation would harm the reputation of that person if living, and is intended to be hurtful to the feelings 
of his family or other …
what_it_means: In simple words: A lender or its recovery agents use threats, abuse or public shaming to collect a loan.

visible representations, makes or publishes in any manner, any imputation concerning any person 
intending to harm, or knowing or having reason to believe that such imputation will harm, the reputation 
of such person, is said, except in the cases hereinafter excepted, to defame that person.

imputation would harm the reputation of that person if living, and is intended to be hurtful to the feelings 
of his family or other …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing 
hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does 
thereby cause hurt to any person, is said “voluntarily to cause hurt”. 
(2) Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub -section ( 1) of section 122 voluntarily causes 
hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, 
or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.
what_it_means: In simple words: Someone deliberately used physical force on you and caused you bodily pain or injury.

conditions: ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ಹೊಡೆದರಾ ಅಥವಾ ತಳ್ಳಿದರಾ? ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ಏನಾಯಿತು? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಇದು ಬೇಕಂತಲೇ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾ ಅಥವಾ ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕವಾಗಿ ಆಯ್ತಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ನಿಮಗೆ ಗಾಯ ಆಯಿತಾ? ಏನಾದರೂ ರಕ್ತ ಅಥವಾ ಊತ ಆಯಿತಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಇದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ದೂರು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ನೀವು ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

information is given to an officer in charge of a police station of the commission within the limits of such 
station of a non-cognizable offence, he shall enter or cause to be entered the substance of the information 
in a book to be kept by such off icer in such form as the State Government may by rules prescribe in this 
behalf, and,— 
(i) refer the informant to the Magistrate; 
(ii) forward the daily diary report of all such cases fortnightly to the Magistrate. 
(2) No police officer shall investigate a non -cognizable case without the order of a Magistrate having 
power to try …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing 
hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does 
thereby cause hurt to any person, is said “voluntarily to cause hurt”. 
(2) Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub -section ( 1) of section 122 voluntarily causes 
hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, 
or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.
what_it_means: In simple words: Someone deliberately used physical force on you and caused you bodily pain or injury.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: Sanjay hit me with a stick near the bus stand on 9 November 2024. My cousin did it on purpose, it was not an accident. I got a cut on my head and it was bleeding.
conditions: Did the person physically hit or push you? What exactly happened? — you said yes
Do you think it was done deliberately, or could it have been an accident? — you said yes
Were you injured? Did you get any cuts, bruises or bleeding? — you said yes
Have you given a complaint to the police about this? — not known yet

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing 
hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does 
thereby cause hurt to any person, is said “voluntarily to cause hurt”. 
(2) Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub -section ( 1) of section 122 voluntarily causes 
hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, 
or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing 
hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does 
thereby cause hurt to any person, is said “voluntarily to cause hurt”. 
(2) Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub -section ( 1) of section 122 voluntarily causes 
hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, 
or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing 
hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does 
thereby cause hurt to any person, is said “voluntarily to cause hurt”. 
(2) Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub -section ( 1) of section 122 voluntarily causes 
hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, 
or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.

why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಆಗಸ್ಟ್ 30, 2026 ರಂದು ನನ್ನ ಕಲೀಗ್ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನ ಹತ್ತಿರ ನನಗೆ ಕೋಲಿನಿಂದ ಹೊಡೆದರು. ಬಹುಶಃ ನಾನು ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಠಾಣೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ದೂರು ಕೊಟ್ಟೆ. ನನ್ನ ತಲೆಗೆ ಗಾಯ ಆಯ್ತು, ರಕ್ತ ಬರ್ತಿತ್ತು.

why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಮೇ 2023 ರಲ್ಲಿ ನೇಹಾ ನನ್ನ ಕಾಲು ಮುರಿತೀನಿ ಅಂತ ಬೆದರಿಕೆ ಹಾಕಿದರು ಅನ್ಸುತ್ತೆ. ಅವರು ಹೀಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಸಲ ಬೆದರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
conditions: ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ಏನು ಹೇಳಿದರು? ನಿಮಗೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಆಸ್ತಿಗೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ ಅಂತ ಬೆದರಿಸಿದರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಯಾಕೆ ಹೀಗೆ ಹೇಳಿದರು — ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಹೆದರಿಸೋಕಾ ಅಥವಾ ಏನಾದರೂ ಮಾಡಿಸೋಕಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ಇದು ಒಂದೇ ಸಲ ಆಯ್ತಾ ಅಥವಾ ತುಂಬಾ ಸಲ ಆಗಿದೆಯಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಇದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ದೂರು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ನೀವು ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: किसी ने आपको डराने या कुछ करवाने के लिए आपको, आपकी इज़्ज़त या संपत्ति को नुकसान पहुँचाने की धमकी दी।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: मुझे लगता है मई 2023 में नेहा ने मुझे टाँगें तोड़ देने की धमकी दी। उन्होंने ऐसी धमकी कई बार दी है।
conditions: उस व्यक्ति ने ठीक-ठीक क्या कहा? क्या आपको, आपके परिवार को या संपत्ति को नुकसान पहुँचाने की धमकी दी? — आपने हाँ कहा
उस व्यक्ति ने ऐसा क्यों कहा — आपको डराने के लिए या आपसे कुछ करवाने के लिए? — अभी पता नहीं
क्या ऐसा एक बार हुआ या कई बार? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या आपने इसके बारे में पुलिस में शिकायत दी है? — आपने ना कहा

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …
what_it_means: In simple words: Someone threatened to harm you, your reputation or property to frighten you or force you to do something.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: I'm not fully sure, but in May 2025 Neha threatened that she would break my legs. My neighbour has threatened me like this many times.
conditions: What exactly did the person say? Did they threaten to harm you, your family or your property? — you said yes
Why do you think the person said this — to frighten you, or to make you do or stop doing something? — not known yet
Has this happened only once, or many times? — you said yes
Have you given a complaint to the police about this? — you said no

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …
what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: किसी ने आपको डराने या कुछ करवाने के लिए आपको, आपकी इज़्ज़त या संपत्ति को नुकसान पहुँचाने की धमकी दी।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: सविता ने यह मुझे डराने के लिए कहा ताकि मैं चुप रहूँ। पाँच महीने पहले सविता ने मुझे टाँगें तोड़ देने की धमकी दी। उन्होंने ऐसी धमकी कई बार दी है।

(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession 
of any person without that person’s consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to 
commit theft. 
Explanation 1.—A thing so long as it is attached to the earth, not being movable property, is not the 
subject of theft; but it becomes capable of being the subject of theft as soon as it is severed from the 
earth. 
Explanation 2.—A moving effected by the same act which affects the severance may be a theft. 
Explanation 3.—A person is said to cause a thing to move by removing an obstacle …

conditions: ಆ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಯಾರೋ ತಗೊಂಡು ಹೋದರು ಅಂತ ಖಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಗೊತ್ತಾ, ಎಲ್ಲೋ ಇಟ್ಟು ಮರೆತಿಲ್ಲ ತಾನೇ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession 
of any person without that person’s consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to 
commit theft. 
Explanation 1.—A thing so long as it is attached to the earth, not being movable property, is not the 
subject of theft; but it becomes capable of being the subject of theft as soon as it is severed from the 
earth. 
Explanation 2.—A moving effected by the same act which affects the severance may be a theft. 
Explanation 3.—A person is said to cause a thing to move by removing an obstacle …
what_it_means: In simple words: Someone dishonestly took your movable property without your consent.

conditions: ಆ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಯಾರೋ ತಗೊಂಡು ಹೋದರು ಅಂತ ಖಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಗೊತ್ತಾ, ಎಲ್ಲೋ ಇಟ್ಟು ಮರೆತಿಲ್ಲ ತಾನೇ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಅದನ್ನು ತಗೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಬಳಸೋಕೆ ಯಾರಿಗಾದರೂ ಅನುಮತಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಅದನ್ನು ವಾಪಸ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟರಾ, ಅಥವಾ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳೋ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ಇದೆಯಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ಇದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ದೂರು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession 
of any person without that person’s consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to 
commit theft. 
Explanation 1.—A thing so long as it is attached to the earth, not being movable property, is not the 
subject of theft; but it becomes capable of being the subject of theft as soon as it is severed from the 
earth. 
Explanation 2.—A moving effected by the same act which affects the severance may be a theft. 
Explanation 3.—A person is said to cause a thing to move by removing an obstacle …

(1) Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession 
of any person without that person’s consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to 
commit theft. 
Explanation 1.—A thing so long as it is attached to the earth, not being movable property, is not the 
subject of theft; but it becomes capable of being the subject of theft as soon as it is severed from the 
earth. 
Explanation 2.—A moving effected by the same act which affects the severance may be a theft.

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession 
of any person without that person’s consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to 
commit theft. 
Explanation 1.—A thing so long as it is attached to the earth, not being movable property, is not the 
subject of theft; but it becomes capable of being the subject of theft as soon as it is severed from the 
earth. 
Explanation 2.—A moving effected by the same act which affects the severance may be a theft. 
Explanation 3.—A person is said to cause a thing to move by removing an obstacle …

(1) Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession 
of any person without that person’s consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to 
commit theft. 
Explanation 1.—A thing so long as it is attached to the earth, not being movable property, is not the 
subject of theft; but it becomes capable of being the subject of theft as soon as it is severed from the 
earth. 
Explanation 2.—A moving effected by the same act which affects the severance may be a theft. 
Explanation 3.—A person is said to cause a thing to move by removing an obstacle …

conditions: ನೀವು ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ಏನು ದೂರು ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ರಿ? ಕಳ್ಳತನ, ಹಲ್ಲೆ, ಬೆದರಿಕೆ ತರಹದ ಅಪರಾಧನಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession 
of any person without that person’s consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to 
commit theft. 
Explanation 1.—A thing so long as it is attached to the earth, not being movable property, is not the 
subject of theft; but it becomes capable of being the subject of theft as soon as it is severed from the 
earth. 
Explanation 2.—A moving effected by the same act which affects the severance may be a theft. 
Explanation 3.—A person is said to cause a thing to move by removing an obstacle …

conditions: ನೀವು ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ಏನು ದೂರು ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ರಿ? ಕಳ್ಳತನ, ಹಲ್ಲೆ, ಬೆದರಿಕೆ ತರಹದ ಅಪರಾಧನಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

conditions: आप पुलिस को क्या बताने गए थे? क्या वो चोरी, मारपीट या धमकी जैसा अपराध था? — आपने हाँ कहा

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession 
of any person without that person’s consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to 
commit theft. 
Explanation 1.—A thing so long as it is attached to the earth, not being movable property, is not the 
subject of theft; but it becomes capable of being the subject of theft as soon as it is severed from the 
earth. 
Explanation 2.—A moving effected by the same act which affects the severance may be a theft. 
Explanation 3.—A person is said to cause a thing to move by removing an obstacle …
what_it_means: In simple words: Someone dishonestly took your movable property without your consent.

earth.

dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to make, alter or destroy 
the whole or any part of a valuable security, or anything which is signed or sea led, and which is capable 
of being converted into a valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for 
a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine. 
Of fraudulent feeds and dispositions of property
what_it_means: In simple words: Someone deceived you with a false promise or statement and dishonestly made you hand over money or property.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: After taking the money, my colleague stopped answering my calls and there was no job. believing her, I paid two lakh rupees in March 2023. I went to the police station and gave a complaint.
conditions: What exactly did the person promise or tell you to get the money? — not known yet
Did you actually give money or anything valuable? How much, and how? — you said yes
After you paid, what did the person do? Did they avoid you or return anything? — you said yes
Have you given a complaint to the police about this? — you said yes
where_to_verify: Read the official text of section 420 of the Indian Penal Code (1860) on India Code (indiacode.nic.in), or ask the District Legal Services Authority for free legal help. This is not legal advice.

what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ಯಾರೋ ಸುಳ್ಳು ಭರವಸೆ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾತಿನಿಂದ ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಅಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕವಾಗಿ ನಿಮ್ಮಿಂದ ದುಡ್ಡು ಅಥವಾ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಪಡೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ದುಡ್ಡು ತಗೊಂಡ ಮೇಲೆ ನನ್ನ ಕಲೀಗ್ ನನ್ನ ಫೋನ್ ಎತ್ತೋದನ್ನೇ ಬಿಟ್ಟರು, ಕೆಲಸನೂ ಸಿಗಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಅವರ ಮಾತು ನಂಬಿ ನಾನು ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2023 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಲಕ್ಷ ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟೆ. ನಾನು ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಠಾಣೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ದೂರು ಕೊಟ್ಟೆ.
conditions: ದುಡ್ಡು ತಗೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ಏನು ಹೇಳಿದರು ಅಥವಾ ಏನು ಮಾತು ಕೊಟ್ಟರು? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ನೀವು ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ದುಡ್ಡು ಅಥವಾ ಬೆಲೆಬಾಳುವ ವಸ್ತು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿರಾ? ಎಷ್ಟು, ಹೇಗೆ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಮೇಲೆ ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಏನು ಮಾಡಿದರು? ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಂಡರಾ ಅಥವಾ ಏನಾದರೂ ವಾಪಸ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಇದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ದೂರು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
where_to_verify: Indian Penal Code (1860) ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 420 ರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಠ್ಯವನ್ನು ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ (indiacode.nic.in) ಓದಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಉಚಿತ ಕಾನೂನು ನೆರವಿಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾನೂನು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆ ಅಲ್ಲ.

what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: किसी ने झूठे वादे या बात से आपको धोखा देकर बेईमानी से आपसे पैसा या संपत्ति ले ली।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: पैसे लेने के बाद मेरी कलीग ने मेरा फ़ोन उठाना बंद कर दिया और नौकरी भी नहीं मिली। उनकी बात पर भरोसा करके मैंने मार्च 2023 में दो लाख रुपये दे दिए। मैं पुलिस स्टेशन गया और शिकायत दर्ज कराई।
conditions: पैसे लेने के लिए उस व्यक्ति ने आपसे ठीक-ठीक क्या वादा किया या क्या कहा? — अभी पता नहीं
क्या आपने सच में पैसे या कोई कीमती चीज़ दी? कितने और कैसे? — आपने हाँ कहा
पैसे देने के बाद उस व्यक्ति ने क्या किया? क्या वो आपसे बचने लगे या कुछ लौटाया? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या आपने इसके बारे में पुलिस में शिकायत दी है? — आपने हाँ कहा
where_to_verify: Indian Penal Code (1860) की धारा 420 का आधिकारिक पाठ इंडिया कोड (indiacode.nic.in) पर पढ़ें, या मुफ़्त कानूनी सहायता के लिए ज़िला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण से संपर्क करें। यह कानूनी सलाह नहीं है।

person so deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to consent that any person shall retain any 
property, or intentionally induces the person so deceived to do or omit to do anything which he would not 
do or omit if he were not so deceived, and which act or omission causes or is likely to cause damage or 
harm to that person in body, mind, reputation or property, is said to cheat.

what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: किसी ने झूठे वादे या बात से आपको धोखा देकर बेईमानी से आपसे पैसा या संपत्ति ले ली।

conditions: पैसे लेने के लिए उस व्यक्ति ने आपसे ठीक-ठीक क्या वादा किया या क्या कहा? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या आपने सच में पैसे या कोई कीमती चीज़ दी? कितने और कैसे? — अभी पता नहीं

why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಜುಲೈ 25, 2022 ರಂದು ಪ್ರಕಾಶ್ ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಟ್ರೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಂಪನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಕೊಡಿಸ್ತೀನಿ ಅಂತ ಮಾತು ಕೊಟ್ಟರು. ನಾನು ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಠಾಣೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ದೂರು ಕೊಟ್ಟೆ ಅನ್ಸುತ್ತೆ. ಅವರ ಮಾತು ನಂಬಿ ನಾನು ಆಗಸ್ಟ್ 2, 2022 ರಂದು ಮೂರು ಲಕ್ಷ ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟೆ.
conditions: ದುಡ್ಡು ತಗೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ಏನು ಹೇಳಿದರು ಅಥವಾ ಏನು ಮಾತು ಕೊಟ್ಟರು? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

pretending to be some other person, or by knowingly substituting one person for or another, or 
representing that he or any other person is a person other than he or such other person really is. 
Explanation.—The offence is committed whether the individual personated is a real or imaginary 
person. 
Illustrations. 
(a) A cheats by pretending to be a certain rich banker of the same name. A cheats by personation. 
(b) A cheats by pretending to be B, a person who is deceased. A cheats by personation. 
(2) Whoever cheats by personation …

conditions: ದುಡ್ಡು ತಗೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ಏನು ಹೇಳಿದರು ಅಥವಾ ಏನು ಮಾತು ಕೊಟ್ಟರು? — ನೀವು ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ನೀವು ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ದುಡ್ಡು ಅಥವಾ ಬೆಲೆಬಾಳುವ ವಸ್ತು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿರಾ? ಎಷ್ಟು, ಹೇಗೆ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಮೇಲೆ ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಏನು ಮಾಡಿದರು? ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಂಡರಾ ಅಥವಾ ಏನಾದರೂ ವಾಪಸ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಇದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ದೂರು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

conditions: ನೀವು ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ಏನು ದೂರು ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ರಿ? ಕಳ್ಳತನ, ಹಲ್ಲೆ, ಬೆದರಿಕೆ ತರಹದ ಅಪರಾಧನಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ನೀವು ಹೋದಾಗ ಪೊಲೀಸರು ಏನು ಮಾಡಿದರು? ದೂರು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿದರಾ? — ನೀವು ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಎಸ್‌ಪಿ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಲಿಖಿತ ದೂರು ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೀರಾ ಅಥವಾ ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಸ್ಟ್ರೇಟ್ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ನೀವು ಗಂಭೀರ (ಕಾಗ್ನಿಜಬಲ್) ಅಪರಾಧದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿದರೂ ಪೊಲೀಸರು ಅದನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಲು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 2023 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಚಯದ ಸಂಜಯ್ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಗೆ ನುಗ್ಗಿ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ತಗೊಂಡು ಹೋದರು ಅಂತ ದೂರು ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಠಾಣೆಗೆ ಹೋದೆ.
conditions: ನೀವು ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ಏನು ದೂರು ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ರಿ? ಕಳ್ಳತನ, ಹಲ್ಲೆ, ಬೆದರಿಕೆ ತರಹದ ಅಪರಾಧನಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಜೂನ್ 30, 2025 ರಂದು ಕೊರಿಯರ್ ಕಂಪನಿಯವರು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿಕೊಂಡು ಒಬ್ಬರು ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಒಂದು ಪೇಮೆಂಟ್ ರಿಕ್ವೆಸ್ಟ್ ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಹೇಳಿದರು. ಪಿನ್ ಹಾಕಿದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ನನ್ನ ಅಕೌಂಟ್‌ನಿಂದ ಹತ್ತು ಸಾವಿರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕಟ್ ಆಯ್ತು. ಅದೇ ದಿನ 1930 ಸೈಬರ್ ಹೆಲ್ಪ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ಗೆ ದೂರು ಕೊಟ್ಟೆ. ದುಡ್ಡು ಹೋದ ಯುಪಿಐ ಐಡಿ ಆಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣ್ತಿದೆ, ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸಾಕ್ಷನ್ ನಂಬರ್ 646528669084.

conditions: ಪಾವತಿಗೆ ಮುಂಚೆ ಯಾರು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿದರು, ಏನು ಹೇಳಿದರು? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

Whoever, fraudulently or dishonestly make use of the

Code (45 of 1860).

in section 43, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or 
with fine which may extend to five lakh rupees or with both.

(a) the word “dishonestly” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 24 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860); 
(b) the word “fraudulently” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 25 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860).

in section 43, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or 
with fine which may extend to five lakh rupees or with both.

(a) the word “dishonestly” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 24 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860); 
(b) the word “fraudulently” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 25 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860).

Code (45 of 1860).

If any person, dishonestly or fraudulently, does any act referred to 
in section 43, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or 
with fine which may extend to five lakh rupees or with both. 
Explanation.–For the purposes of this section,– 
(a) the word “dishonestly” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 24 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860); 
(b) the word “fraudulently” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 25 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860).

why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಅದಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಯಾರೋ ನನ್ನ ಅಕೌಂಟ್‌ಗೆ ಲಾಗಿನ್ ಆಗಿ ಫೋನ್ ನಂಬರ್ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿದರು. ಜುಲೈ 28, 2023 ರಂದು ಕೆವೈಸಿ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಪೈರ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಂತ ಅವರು ಒಂದು ಲಿಂಕ್ ಇರೋ ಎಸ್‌ಎಂಎಸ್ ಕಳಿಸಿದರು.
conditions: ಇದು ಆಗೋ ಮುಂಚೆ ನಿಮಗೆ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಇರೋ ಎಸ್‌ಎಂಎಸ್, ಇಮೇಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಕಾಲ್ ಬಂದಿತ್ತಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

what_it_says:
If any person, dishonestly or fraudulently, does any act referred to 
in section 43, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or 
with fine which may extend to five lakh rupees or with both. 
Explanation.–For the purposes of this section,– 
(a) the word “dishonestly” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 24 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860); 
(b) the word “fraudulently” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 25 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860).

conditions: ಇದು ಆಗೋ ಮುಂಚೆ ನಿಮಗೆ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಇರೋ ಎಸ್‌ಎಂಎಸ್, ಇಮೇಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಕಾಲ್ ಬಂದಿತ್ತಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

ಬೇರೆ ಯಾರಾದರೂ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಲಾಗಿನ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದಾರಾ ಅಥವಾ ವಿವರ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿದ್ದಾರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

what_it_says:
If any person, dishonestly or fraudulently, does any act referred to 
in section 43, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or 
with fine which may extend to five lakh rupees or with both. 
Explanation.–For the purposes of this section,– 
(a) the word “dishonestly” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 24 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860); 
(b) the word “fraudulently” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 25 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860).

what_it_says:
If any person, dishonestly or fraudulently, does any act referred to 
in section 43, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or 
with fine which may extend to five lakh rupees or with both. 
Explanation.–For the purposes of this section,– 
(a) the word “dishonestly” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 24 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860); 
(b) the word “fraudulently” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 25 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860).

what_it_says:
(1) A person is said to cheat by personation if he cheats by 
pretending to be some other person, or by knowingly substituting one person for or another, or 
representing that he or any other person is a person other than he or such other person really is. 
Explanation.—The offence is committed whether the individual personated is a real or imaginary 
person. 
Illustrations. 
(a) A cheats by pretending to be a certain rich banker of the same name. A cheats by personation. 
(b) A cheats by pretending to be B, a person who is deceased. A cheats by personation. 
(2) Whoever cheats by personation …

(1) A person is said to cheat by personation if he cheats by 
pretending to be some other person, or by knowingly substituting one person for or another, or 
representing that he or any other person is a person other than he or such other person really is. 
Explanation.—The offence is committed whether the individual personated is a real or imaginary 
person. 
Illustrations. 
(a) A cheats by pretending to be a certain rich banker of the same name. A cheats by personation. 
(b) A cheats by pretending to be B, a person who is deceased. A cheats by personation. 
(2) Whoever cheats by personation …

pretending to be some other person, or by knowingly substituting one person for or another, or 
representing that he or any other person is a person other than he or such other person really is.

person. 
Illustrations.

(1) A person is said to cheat by personation if he cheats by 
pretending to be some other person, or by knowingly substituting one person for or another, or 
representing that he or any other person is a person other than he or such other person really is. 
Explanation.—The offence is committed whether the individual personated is a real or imaginary 
person. 
Illustrations. 
(a) A cheats by pretending to be a certain rich banker of the same name. A cheats by personation. 
(b) A cheats by pretending to be B, a person who is deceased. A cheats by personation. 
(2) Whoever cheats by personation …
what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ಯಾರೋ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರು ಮತ್ತು ಫೋಟೋ ಬಳಸಿ ನಕಲಿ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಮೂಲಕ ನೀವೇ ಅಂತ ನಟಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ನವೆಂಬರ್ 9, 2025 ರಂದು ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು, ಫೋಟೋ ಹಾಕಿ ನಕಲಿ ಸೋಶಿಯಲ್ ಮೀಡಿಯಾ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಆ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್‌ನಿಂದ ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರಲ್ಲಿ ನನ್ನ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್ ಹತ್ತಿರ ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ನಾನು ಆ ನಕಲಿ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಪ್‌ಗೆ ರಿಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಆಕ್ಟಿವ್ ಇದೆ.
conditions: ನೀವು ಮಾಡದೇ ಇರೋ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರು ಅಥವಾ ಫೋಟೋ ಬಳಸಿರೋ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಏನಾದರೂ ಇದೆಯಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಆ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್‌ನಿಂದ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್‌ಗೆ ಮೆಸೇಜ್ ಬಂದಿದೆಯಾ ಅಥವಾ ಯಾರಿಗಾದರೂ ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೇಳಿದ್ದಾರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ನಕಲಿ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಪ್ ಅಥವಾ ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್‌ಗೆ ರಿಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

Whoever, fraudulently or dishonestly make use of the 
electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person, shall be 
punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall 
also be liable to fine which may extend to rupees one lakh.

what_it_says:
(1) A person is said to cheat by personation if he cheats by 
pretending to be some other person, or by knowingly substituting one person for or another, or 
representing that he or any other person is a person other than he or such other person really is. 
Explanation.—The offence is committed whether the individual personated is a real or imaginary 
person. 
Illustrations. 
(a) A cheats by pretending to be a certain rich banker of the same name. A cheats by personation. 
(b) A cheats by pretending to be B, a person who is deceased. A cheats by personation. 
(2) Whoever cheats by personation …

Whoever, fraudulently or dishonestly make use of the 
electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person, shall be 
punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall 
also be liable to fine which may extend to rupees one lakh.

pretending to be some other person, or by knowingly substituting one person for or another, or 
representing that he or any other person is a person other than he or such other person really is.

what_it_says:
(1) Any man who— 
(i) follows a woman and contacts, or attempts to contact such woman to foster personal 
interaction repeatedly despite a clear indication of disinterest by such woman; or 
(ii) monitors the use by a woman of the internet, e -mail or any other form of electronic 
communication, 
commits the offence of stalking: 
Provided that such conduct shall not amount to stalking if the man who pursued it proves that— 
(i) it was pursued for the purpose of preventing or detecting crime and the man accused of 
stalking had been entrusted with the responsibility of prevention and detection …

person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested,

bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation.

what_it_says:
(1) Any man who— 
(i) follows a woman and contacts, or attempts to contact such woman to foster personal 
interaction repeatedly despite a clear indication of disinterest by such woman; or 
(ii) monitors the use by a woman of the internet, email or any other form of electronic 
communication, 
commits the offence of stalking: 
Provided that such conduct shall not amount to stalking if the man who pursued it pr oves 
that— 
(i) it was pursued for the purpose of preventing or detecting crime and the man accuse d 
of stalking had been entrusted with the responsibility of prevention and detection …

what_it_says:
(1) Any man who— 
(i) follows a woman and contacts, or attempts to contact such woman to foster personal 
interaction repeatedly despite a clear indication of disinterest by such woman; or 
(ii) monitors the use by a woman of the internet, email or any other form of electronic 
communication, 
commits the offence of stalking: 
Provided that such conduct shall not amount to stalking if the man who pursued it pr oves 
that— 
(i) it was pursued for the purpose of preventing or detecting crime and the man accuse d 
of stalking had been entrusted with the responsibility of prevention and detection …

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …

the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation.

threatened is interested, is within this section. …

(1) Any man who— 
(i) follows a woman and contacts, or attempts to contact such woman to foster personal

commits the offence of stalking:

person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested,

bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation.

threatened is interested, is within this section. …

Whoever, intentionally or knowingly captures, publishes 
or transmits the image of a private area of any person without his or her consent, under circumstances 
violating the privacy of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to three years 
or with fine not exceeding two lakh rupees, or with both. 
Explanation.–For the purposes of this section– 
(a) “transmit” means to electronically send a visual image with the intent that it be viewed by a 
person or persons; 
(b) “capture”, with respect to an image, means to videotape, photograph, film or record by any 
means; …

Whoever, intending to insult 
the modesty of any woman, utters any words, makes any sound or gesture, or exhibits any object in any 
form, intending that such word or sound shall be heard, or that such gesture or object shall be seen, by 
such woman, or intrudes upon the privacy of such woman, shall be punished with simple imprisonment 
for a term which may extend to three years, and also with fine.

conditions: क्या आपकी फ़ोटो एडिट की गई या आपकी जानकारी के बिना कोई निजी तस्वीर ली गई? — आपने हाँ कहा

what_it_says:
Whoever, intentionally or knowingly captures, publishes 
or transmits the image of a private area of any person without his or her consent, under circumstances 
violating the privacy of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to three years 
or with fine not exceeding two lakh rupees, or with both. 
Explanation.–For the purposes of this section– 
(a) “transmit” means to electronically send a visual image with the intent that it be viewed by a 
person or persons; 
(b) “capture”, with respect to an image, means to videotape, photograph, film or record by any 
means; …

the modesty of any woman, utters any words, makes any sound or gesture, or exhibits any object in any 
form, intending that such word or sound shall be heard, or that such gesture or object shall be seen, by 
such woman, or intrudes upon the privacy of such woman, shall be punished with simple imprisonment 
for a term which may extend to three years, and also with fine. 
Of offences relating to marriage
what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಯಾರೋ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅಶ್ಲೀಲ ಅಥವಾ ಖಾಸಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ, ಎಡಿಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ, ಹಂಚಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಹಂಚುತ್ತೇವೆ ಅಂತ ಬೆದರಿಸ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ನನ್ನ ಫೋಟೋಗಳನ್ನು ಹೀಗೆ ಬಳಸೋಕೆ ನಾನು ಯಾವತ್ತೂ ಒಪ್ಪಿಲ್ಲ. ನನ್ನ ಎಕ್ಸ್ ಬಾಯ್‌ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ ಬಸವರಾಜ್ ಆ ಫೋಟೋವನ್ನು ವಾಟ್ಸಾಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಕರಿಗೆ ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
conditions: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋಟೋ ಎಡಿಟ್ ಮಾಡಲಾಗಿದೆಯಾ ಅಥವಾ ನಿಮಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಖಾಸಗಿ ಫೋಟೋ ತೆಗೆದಿದ್ದಾರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ಆ ಫೋಟೋ ಬಳಸೋಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಹಂಚೋಕೆ ನೀವು ಯಾವತ್ತಾದರೂ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ನಿಮಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿರೋ ಮಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಆ ಫೋಟೋ ಯಾರಿಗಾದರೂ ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾರಾ ಅಥವಾ ಎಲ್ಲಾದರೂ ಹಾಕಿದ್ದಾರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

what_it_says:
Whoever, intentionally or knowingly captures, publishes 
or transmits the image of a private area of any person without his or her consent, under circumstances 
violating the privacy of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to three years 
or with fine not exceeding two lakh rupees, or with both. 
Explanation.–For the purposes of this section– 
(a) “transmit” means to electronically send a visual image with the intent that it be viewed by a 
person or persons; 
(b) “capture”, with respect to an image, means to videotape, photograph, film or record by any 
means; …

electronic form any material which contains sexually explicit act or conduct shall be punished on first 
conviction with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to five years and with 
fine which may extend to ten lakh rupees and in the event of second or subsequent conviction with 
imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years and also with fine which 
may extend to ten lakh rupees.

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …

what_it_says:
Whoever, intentionally or knowingly captures, publishes 
or transmits the image of a private area of any person without his or her consent, under circumstances 
violating the privacy of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to three years 
or with fine not exceeding two lakh rupees, or with both. 
Explanation.–For the purposes of this section– 
(a) “transmit” means to electronically send a visual image with the intent that it be viewed by a 
person or persons; 
(b) “capture”, with respect to an image, means to videotape, photograph, film or record by any 
means; …

what_it_says:
(1) Any marriage solemnized, whether before or after the commencement of this Act, 
may, on a petition presented by either the husband or the wife, be dissolved by a decree of divorce on the 
ground that the other party— 
[(i) has, after the solemnization of the marriage, had voluntary sexual intercourse with any 
person other than his or her spouse; or 
(ia) has, after the solemnization of the marriage, treated the petitioner with cruelty; or 
(ib) has deserted the petitioner for a continuous period of not less than two years immediately 
preceding the presentation of the petition; or] 
(ii) …
what_it_means: In simple words: Ending a marriage through the family court, either by mutual consent or on a ground such as cruelty or desertion.

conditions: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗಂಡ ಈಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಖರ್ಚಿಗೆ ಏನಾದರೂ ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಡ್ತಿದ್ದಾರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

what_it_says:
(1) While disposing of an application under sub-section (1) of section 12, the 
Magistrate may direct the respondent to pay monetary relief to meet the expenses incurred and losses 
suffered by the aggrieved person and any child of the aggrieved person as a result of the domestic 
violence and such relief may include, but not limited to,— 
(a) the loss of earnings; 
(b) the medical expenses; 
(c) the loss caused due to the destruction, damage or removal of any property from the control of 
the aggrieved person; and 
(d) the maintenance for the aggrieved person as well as her children, if any, …
what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: जिस पति के पास साधन हैं लेकिन वो अपना गुज़ारा न कर सकने वाली पत्नी की उपेक्षा करता है, उसे मासिक भरण-पोषण देने का आदेश दिया जा सकता है।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: मेरे पति अच्छा कमाते हैं, शहर में उनकी दुकान है। मुझे लगता है मेरी अपनी कोई नौकरी या कमाई नहीं है।
conditions: क्या आपके पति अभी आपके खर्च के लिए कोई पैसा दे रहे हैं? — अभी पता नहीं
क्या आपकी अपनी कोई नौकरी या आमदनी है? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या आपके पति की कोई नौकरी, कारोबार या दूसरी आमदनी है? लगभग कितनी? — आपने हाँ कहा
where_to_verify: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act (2005) की धारा 20 का आधिकारिक पाठ इंडिया कोड (indiacode.nic.in) पर पढ़ें, या मुफ़्त कानूनी सहायता के लिए ज़िला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण से संपर्क करें। यह कानूनी सलाह नहीं है।

what_it_says:
(1) If any person having sufficient 
means neglects or refuses to maintain— 
(a) his wife, unable to maintain herself; or 
(b) his legitimate or illegitimate child, whether married or not, unable to maintain itself; or 
(c) his legitimate or illegitimate child (not being a married daughter) who has attained majority, 
where such child is, by reason of any physical or mental abnormality or injury unable to maintain itself; 
or 
(d) his father or mother, unable to maintain himself or herself, 
a Magistrate of the first class may, upon proof of such neglect or refusal, order such person to make …
what_it_means: In simple words: A spouse who has enough means but neglects or refuses to support a wife who cannot maintain herself can be ordered to pay monthly maintenance.

what_it_says:
(1) If any person having sufficient 
means neglects or refuses to maintain— 
(a) his wife, unable to maintain herself; or 
(b) his legitimate or illegitimate child, whether married or not, unable to maintain itself; or 
(c) his legitimate or illegitimate child (not being a married daughter) who has attained majority, 
where such child is, by reason of any physical or mental abnormality or injury unable to maintain itself; 
or 
(d) his father or mother, unable to maintain himself or herself, 
a Magistrate of the first class may, upon proof of such neglect or refusal, order such person to make …

what_it_says:
(1) While disposing of an application under sub-section (1) of section 12, the 
Magistrate may direct the respondent to pay monetary relief to meet the expenses incurred and losses 
suffered by the aggrieved person and any child of the aggrieved person as a result of the domestic 
violence and such relief may include, but not limited to,— 
(a) the loss of earnings; 
(b) the medical expenses; 
(c) the loss caused due to the destruction, damage or removal of any property from the control of 
the aggrieved person; and 
(d) the maintenance for the aggrieved person as well as her children, if any, …

(1) While disposing of an application under sub-section (1) of section 12, the 
Magistrate may direct the respondent to pay monetary relief to meet the expenses incurred and losses 
suffered by the aggrieved person and any child of the aggrieved person as a result of the domestic 
violence and such relief may include, but not limited to,— 
(a) the loss of earnings; 
(b) the medical expenses; 
(c) the loss caused due to the destruction, damage or removal of any property from the control of 
the aggrieved person; and 
(d) the maintenance for the aggrieved person as well as her children, if any, …
what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ಇದ್ದರೂ, ತನ್ನನ್ನು ತಾನು ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಾಗದ ಹೆಂಡತಿಯನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷಿಸುವ ಗಂಡನಿಗೆ ಮಾಸಿಕ ಜೀವನಾಂಶ ಕೊಡಲು ಆದೇಶಿಸಬಹುದು.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ನನಗೆ ಸ್ವಂತ ಕೆಲಸ ಅಥವಾ ಆದಾಯ ಇಲ್ಲ.
conditions: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗಂಡ ಈಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಖರ್ಚಿಗೆ ಏನಾದರೂ ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಡ್ತಿದ್ದಾರಾ? — ನೀವು ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ನಿಮಗೆ ಸ್ವಂತ ಕೆಲಸ ಅಥವಾ ಆದಾಯ ಏನಾದರೂ ಇದೆಯಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗಂಡನಿಗೆ ಕೆಲಸ, ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಅಥವಾ ಬೇರೆ ಆದಾಯ ಇದೆಯಾ? ಸುಮಾರು ಎಷ್ಟು? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
where_to_verify: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act (2005) ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 20 ರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಠ್ಯವನ್ನು ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ (indiacode.nic.in) ಓದಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಉಚಿತ ಕಾನೂನು ನೆರವಿಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾನೂನು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆ ಅಲ್ಲ.

what_it_says:
(1) If any person having sufficient 
means neglects or refuses to maintain— 
(a) his wife, unable to maintain herself; or 
(b) his legitimate or illegitimate child, whether married or not, unable to maintain itself; or 
(c) his legitimate or illegitimate child (not being a married daughter) who has attained majority, 
where such child is, by reason of any physical or mental abnormality or injury unable to maintain itself; 
or 
(d) his father or mother, unable to maintain himself or herself, 
a Magistrate of the first class may, upon proof of such neglect or refusal, order such person to make …
what_it_means: In simple words: A spouse who has enough means but neglects or refuses to support a wife who cannot maintain herself can be ordered to pay monthly maintenance.

what_it_says:
(1) If any person having sufficient 
means neglects or refuses to maintain— 
(a) his wife, unable to maintain herself; or 
(b) his legitimate or illegitimate child, whether married or not, unable to maintain itself; or 
(c) his legitimate or illegitimate child (not being a married daughter) who has attained majority, 
where such child is, by reason of any physical or mental abnormality or injury unable to maintain itself; 
or 
(d) his father or mother, unable to maintain himself or herself, 
a Magistrate of the first class may, upon proof of such neglect or refusal, order such person to make …
what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: जिस पति के पास साधन हैं लेकिन वो अपना गुज़ारा न कर सकने वाली पत्नी की उपेक्षा करता है, उसे मासिक भरण-पोषण देने का आदेश दिया जा सकता है।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: कुछ समय पहले शिवण्णा ने घर खर्च के पैसे देना बंद कर दिया। शायद मेरी अपनी कोई नौकरी या कमाई नहीं है।
conditions: क्या आपके पति अभी आपके खर्च के लिए कोई पैसा दे रहे हैं? — आपने हाँ कहा

what_it_says:
(1) While disposing of an application under sub-section (1) of section 12, the 
Magistrate may direct the respondent to pay monetary relief to meet the expenses incurred and losses 
suffered by the aggrieved person and any child of the aggrieved person as a result of the domestic 
violence and such relief may include, but not limited to,— 
(a) the loss of earnings; 
(b) the medical expenses; 
(c) the loss caused due to the destruction, damage or removal of any property from the control of 
the aggrieved person; and 
(d) the maintenance for the aggrieved person as well as her children, if any, …
what_it_means: In simple words: A spouse who has enough means but neglects or refuses to support a wife who cannot maintain herself can be ordered to pay monthly maintenance.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: Some time back Shivanna stopped giving me any money for household expenses. I'm not fully sure, but I have no job or income of my own.

conditions: ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ವಯಸ್ಸು? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ಮಗುವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ನಿಮಗೆ ಸಮಯ, ಆದಾಯ, ಇರೋಕೆ ಜಾಗ ಇದೆಯಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

(a) any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide 
or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physi cal) of the woman; 
or 
(b) harassment of the woman where such harassment is with a view to coercing her or any person 
related to …

what_it_says:
For the purposes of section 85, “cruelty” means— 
(a) any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide 
or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physical) of the woman; 
or 
(b) harassment of the woman where such harassment is with a view to coercing her or any person 
related to her to meet any unlawful demand for any property or valuable security or is on account of 
failure by her or any person related to her to meet such demand.

or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physi cal) of the woman; 
or

related to …

what_it_says:
For the purposes of section 85, “cruelty” means— 
(a) any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide 
or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physical) of the woman; 
or 
(b) harassment of the woman where such harassment is with a view to coercing her or any person 
related to her to meet any unlawful demand for any property or valuable security or is on account of 
failure by her or any person related to her to meet such demand.

failure by her or any person related to her to meet such demand.

(a) any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide 
or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physical) of the woman;

related to her to meet any unlawful demand for any property or valuable security or is on account of

For the purposes of section 85, “cruelty” means— 
(a) any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide 
or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physical) of the woman; 
or 
(b) harassment of the woman where such harassment is with a view to coercing her or any person 
related to her to meet any unlawful demand for any property or valuable security or is on account of 
failure by her or any person related to her to meet such demand.

For the purposes of section 85, “cruelty” means— 
(a) any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide 
or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physical) of the woman; 
or 
(b) harassment of the woman where such harassment is with a view to coercing her or any person 
related to her to meet any unlawful demand for any property or valuable security or is on account of 
failure by her or any person related to her to meet such demand.

(1) On and from the commencement of the 
Hindu Succession (Amendment) Act, 2005 (39 of 2005) , in a Joint Hindu family governed by the 
Mitakshara law, the daughter of a coparcener shall,― 
(a) by birth become a coparcener in her own right the same manner as the son; 
(b) have the same rights in the coparcenery property as she would have had if she had been a son; 
(c) be subject to the same liabilities in respect of the said coparcenery property as that of a son, 
and any reference to a Hindu Mitakshara coparcener shall be deemed to include a reference to a daughter 
of a coparcener: …
what_it_means: In simple words: Heirs of family property can ask for their legal share and for the property to be divided.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: the house is ancestral property; nobody bought it. I am also a legal heir, so I should get an equal share.
conditions: Did the property come down in the family, or did someone buy it with their own money? — you said yes

what_it_says:
(1) On and from the commencement of the 
Hindu Succession (Amendment) Act, 2005 (39 of 2005) , in a Joint Hindu family governed by the 
Mitakshara law, the daughter of a coparcener shall,― 
(a) by birth become a coparcener in her own right the same manner as the son; 
(b) have the same rights in the coparcenery property as she would have had if she had been a son; 
(c) be subject to the same liabilities in respect of the said coparcenery property as that of a son, 
and any reference to a Hindu Mitakshara coparcener shall be deemed to include a reference to a daughter 
of a coparcener: …

what_it_says:
The property of a male Hindu dying intestate 
shall devolve according to the provisions of this Chapter:― 
(a) firstly, upon the heirs, being the relatives specified in class I of the Schedule; 
(b) secondly, if there is no heir of class I, then upon the heirs, being the relatives specif ied in 
class II of the Schedule; 
(c) thirdly, if there is no heir of any of the two classes, then upon the agnates of the deceased; and 
(d) lastly, if there is no agnate, then upon the cognates of the deceased.
what_it_means: In simple words: Heirs of family property can ask for their legal share and for the property to be divided.

(d) lastly, if there is no agnate, then upon the cognates of the deceased.

what_it_says:
The property of a male Hindu dying intestate 
shall devolve according to the provisions of this Chapter:― 
(a) firstly, upon the heirs, being the relatives specified in class I of the Schedule; 
(b) secondly, if there is no heir of class I, then upon the heirs, being the relatives specif ied in 
class II of the Schedule; 
(c) thirdly, if there is no heir of any of the two classes, then upon the agnates of the deceased; and 
(d) lastly, if there is no agnate, then upon the cognates of the deceased.

what_it_says:
The property of a male Hindu dying intestate 
shall devolve according to the provisions of this Chapter:― 
(a) firstly, upon the heirs, being the relatives specified in class I of the Schedule; 
(b) secondly, if there is no heir of class I, then upon the heirs, being the relatives specif ied in 
class II of the Schedule; 
(c) thirdly, if there is no heir of any of the two classes, then upon the agnates of the deceased; and 
(d) lastly, if there is no agnate, then upon the cognates of the deceased.

The property of a male Hindu dying intestate 
shall devolve according to the provisions of this Chapter:― 
(a) firstly, upon the heirs, being the relatives specified in class I of the Schedule; 
(b) secondly, if there is no heir of class I, then upon the heirs, being the relatives specif ied in 
class II of the Schedule; 
(c) thirdly, if there is no heir of any of the two classes, then upon the agnates of the deceased; and 
(d) lastly, if there is no agnate, then upon the cognates of the deceased.

The property of a male Hindu dying intestate 
shall devolve according to the provisions of this Chapter:― 
(a) firstly, upon the heirs, being the relatives specified in class I of the Schedule; 
(b) secondly, if there is no heir of class I, then upon the heirs, being the relatives specif ied in 
class II of the Schedule; 
(c) thirdly, if there is no heir of any of the two classes, then upon the agnates of the deceased; and 
(d) lastly, if there is no agnate, then upon the cognates of the deceased.

valuable security or a will, or an authority to adopt a son, or which purports to give authority to any 
person to make or transfer any valuable security, or to receive the principal, interest or dividends thereon, 
or to receive or deliver any money, movable property, or valuable security, or any document purporting 
to be an acquittance or receipt acknowledging the payment of money, or an acquittance or receipt for the 
delivery of any movable property or valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or 
with imprisonment …
what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ಯಾರೋ ವಿಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಸೇಲ್ ಡೀಡ್ ತರಹದ ನಕಲಿ ದಾಖಲೆ ಮಾಡಿ, ಅದನ್ನು ನಿಜವೆಂದು ಬಳಸಿ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಹಕ್ಕು ಕೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಅದರಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಸಹಿ ನಿಜವಾದದ್ದು ಅಲ್ಲ, ನಕಲಿ ಸಹಿ. ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ದಿನದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಅವರು ಆ ವಿಲ್ ಬಳಸಿ ಖಾತಾ ತಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿಕೊಂಡರು.
conditions: ಯಾವ ದಾಖಲೆ ನಕಲಿ ಅಂತ ನಿಮಗೆ ಅನ್ಸುತ್ತೆ — ವಿಲ್, ಸೇಲ್ ಡೀಡ್, ದಾನಪತ್ರ? ಯಾರು ಮಾಡಿದ್ದು? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ಆ ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಸಹಿ ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಬ್ಬೆಟ್ಟು ನಿಜವಾದದ್ದಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಆ ದಾಖಲೆಯನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲಾದರೂ ಬಳಸಿದ್ದಾರಾ — ಖಾತಾ, ಪಹಣಿ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸೋಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾರೋಕೆ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

(1) On and from the commencement of the 
Hindu Succession (Amendment) Act, 2005 (39 of 2005) , in a Joint Hindu family governed by the 
Mitakshara law, the daughter of a coparcener shall,― 
(a) by birth become a coparcener in her own right the same manner as the son; 
(b) have the same rights in the coparcenery property as she would have had if she had been a son; 
(c) be subject to the same liabilities in respect of the said coparcenery property as that of a son, 
and any reference to a Hindu Mitakshara coparcener shall be deemed to include a reference to a daughter 
of a coparcener: …

what_it_says:
(1) On and from the commencement of the 
Hindu Succession (Amendment) Act, 2005 (39 of 2005) , in a Joint Hindu family governed by the 
Mitakshara law, the daughter of a coparcener shall,― 
(a) by birth become a coparcener in her own right the same manner as the son; 
(b) have the same rights in the coparcenery property as she would have had if she had been a son; 
(c) be subject to the same liabilities in respect of the said coparcenery property as that of a son, 
and any reference to a Hindu Mitakshara coparcener shall be deemed to include a reference to a daughter 
of a coparcener: …

what_it_says:
The property of a male Hindu dying intestate 
shall devolve according to the provisions of this Chapter:― 
(a) firstly, upon the heirs, being the relatives specified in class I of the Schedule; 
(b) secondly, if there is no heir of class I, then upon the heirs, being the relatives specif ied in 
class II of the Schedule; 
(c) thirdly, if there is no heir of any of the two classes, then upon the agnates of the deceased; and 
(d) lastly, if there is no agnate, then upon the cognates of the deceased.
what_it_means: In simple words: Heirs of family property can ask for their legal share and for the property to be divided.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: I think the house is ancestral property; nobody bought it. on 11 January 2026 my paternal uncle Shivanna refused to give me my share and said the whole property is his.
conditions: Did the property come down in the family, or did someone buy it with their own money? — you said yes

or voidable, and who has reasonable apprehension that such instrument, if left outstanding may cause him

shall also send a copy of its decree to the officer in whose office the instrument has been so registered; and 
such officer shall note on the copy of the instrument …

(1) On and from the commencement of the 
Hindu Succession (Amendment) Act, 2005 (39 of 2005) , in a Joint Hindu family governed by the 
Mitakshara law, the daughter of a coparcener shall,― 
(a) by birth become a coparcener in her own right the same manner as the son; 
(b) have the same rights in the coparcenery property as she would have had if she had been a son; 
(c) be subject to the same liabilities in respect of the said coparcenery property as that of a son,

The property of a male Hindu dying intestate 
shall devolve according to the provisions of this Chapter:― 
(a) firstly, upon the heirs, being the relatives specified in class I of the Schedule; 
(b) secondly, if there is no heir of class I, then upon the heirs, being the relatives specif ied in 
class II of the Schedule; 
(c) thirdly, if there is no heir of any of the two classes, then upon the agnates of the deceased; and 
(d) lastly, if there is no agnate, then upon the cognates of the deceased.

what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: किसी ने आपकी अनुमति के बिना आपकी ज़मीन के हिस्से पर कब्ज़ा या निर्माण कर लिया है।

conditions: ज़मीन किसके नाम पर है? क्या आपके पास सेल डीड या खाता है? — अभी पता नहीं

what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅನುಮತಿ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಯಾರೋ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜಾಗದ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತುವರಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಕಟ್ಟಡ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಸೈಟ್ ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರಲ್ಲಿ ರಿಜಿಸ್ಟರ್ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಜುಲೈ 16, 2025 ರಂದು ಪಕ್ಕದ ಮನೆಯವರು ನನ್ನ ಜಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು ಹತ್ತು ಅಡಿ ಒಳಗೆ ಗೋಡೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು.
conditions: ಜಾಗ ಯಾರ ಹೆಸರಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ? ಸೇಲ್ ಡೀಡ್ ಅಥವಾ ಖಾತಾ ಇದೆಯಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

ಸರ್ವೇ ಇಲಾಖೆಯಿಂದ ಜಾಗ ಅಳತೆ ಆಗಿದೆಯಾ? ನಕ್ಷೆ ಏನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತೆ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

immovable property may recover it in the manner provided by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 
(5 of 1908).

what_it_says:
A person entitled to the possession of specific 
immovable property may recover it in the manner provided by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 
(5 of 1908).
what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅನುಮತಿ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಯಾರೋ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜಾಗದ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತುವರಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಕಟ್ಟಡ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಆಗಸ್ಟ್ 16, 2025 ರಂದು ಕಾವ್ಯ ನನ್ನ ಜಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು ಹತ್ತು ಅಡಿ ಒಳಗೆ ಗೋಡೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು. ಸೈಟ್ ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರಲ್ಲಿ ರಿಜಿಸ್ಟರ್ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸರ್ವೇ ನಕ್ಷೆ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಗೋಡೆ ನನ್ನ ಗಡಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಇದೆ.
conditions: ಜಾಗ ಯಾರ ಹೆಸರಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ? ಸೇಲ್ ಡೀಡ್ ಅಥವಾ ಖಾತಾ ಇದೆಯಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಪಕ್ಕದವರು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ಏನು ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ — ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರಾ, ಬೇಲಿ ಹಾಕಿದ್ದಾರಾ, ಬಳಸ್ತಿದ್ದಾರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಸರ್ವೇ ಇಲಾಖೆಯಿಂದ ಜಾಗ ಅಳತೆ ಆಗಿದೆಯಾ? ನಕ್ಷೆ ಏನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತೆ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
where_to_verify: Specific Relief Act (1963) ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 5 ರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಠ್ಯವನ್ನು ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ (indiacode.nic.in) ಓದಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಉಚಿತ ಕಾನೂನು ನೆರವಿಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾನೂನು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆ ಅಲ್ಲ.

what_it_says:
A person entitled to the possession of specific 
immovable property may recover it in the manner provided by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908

what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: किसी ने आपकी अनुमति के बिना आपकी ज़मीन के हिस्से पर कब्ज़ा या निर्माण कर लिया है।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: 16 अगस्त 2025 को काव्या ने मेरी ज़मीन में लगभग दस फ़ुट अंदर दीवार बना दी। प्लॉट मेरे नाम पर रजिस्टर्ड है। सरकारी सर्वे नक्शे के हिसाब से दीवार मेरी सीमा के अंदर है।
conditions: ज़मीन किसके नाम पर है? क्या आपके पास सेल डीड या खाता है? — आपने हाँ कहा
पड़ोसी ने आपकी ज़मीन पर ठीक-ठीक क्या किया है — कुछ बनाया, बाड़ लगाई या इस्तेमाल करने लगे? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या सर्वे विभाग ने ज़मीन नापी है? नक्शा क्या दिखाता है? — अभी पता नहीं
where_to_verify: Specific Relief Act (1963) की धारा 5 का आधिकारिक पाठ इंडिया कोड (indiacode.nic.in) पर पढ़ें, या मुफ़्त कानूनी सहायता के लिए ज़िला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण से संपर्क करें। यह कानूनी सलाह नहीं है।

person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation.

threatened is interested, is within this section. …

what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅನುಮತಿ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಯಾರೋ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜಾಗದ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತುವರಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಕಟ್ಟಡ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸರ್ವೇ ನಕ್ಷೆ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಗೋಡೆ ನನ್ನ ಗಡಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಇದೆ. ಜೂನ್ 23, 2025 ರಂದು ಪಕ್ಕದ ಮನೆಯವರು ನನ್ನ ಜಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು ಹತ್ತು ಅಡಿ ಒಳಗೆ ಗೋಡೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು ಅನ್ಸುತ್ತೆ.
conditions: ಜಾಗ ಯಾರ ಹೆಸರಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ? ಸೇಲ್ ಡೀಡ್ ಅಥವಾ ಖಾತಾ ಇದೆಯಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

ಸರ್ವೇ ಇಲಾಖೆಯಿಂದ ಜಾಗ ಅಳತೆ ಆಗಿದೆಯಾ? ನಕ್ಷೆ ಏನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತೆ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

conditions: ಈ ಆಸ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ಪಾಲು ಇದೆಯಾ? ಯಾವತ್ತಾದರೂ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪಾಲು ಬಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …
what_it_means: In simple words: Someone threatened to harm you, your reputation or property to frighten you or force you to do something.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: last year my cousin threatened that he would break my legs. he has threatened me like this many times.

conditions: ಈ ಆಸ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ಪಾಲು ಇದೆಯಾ? ಯಾವತ್ತಾದರೂ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪಾಲು ಬಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

conditions: क्या इस संपत्ति में आपका हिस्सा है? क्या आपने कभी अपना हिस्सा छोड़ा है? — अभी पता नहीं

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …

conditions: क्या सीमा के पत्थर या बाड़ हटाई गई? किसने और कब? — आपने हाँ कहा

why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ನನ್ನ ಜಮೀನು ಸರ್ವೇ ನಂಬರ್ 36/3, ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿದೆ. ಹೋದ ವರ್ಷ ಅವರು ಗಡಿ ಕಲ್ಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಿತ್ತು ನನ್ನ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಹಾಕಿದರು.
conditions: ಗಡಿ ಕಲ್ಲು ಅಥವಾ ಬೇಲಿ ಸರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆಯಾ? ಯಾರು, ಯಾವಾಗ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜಮೀನಿನ ಸರ್ವೇ ನಂಬರ್ ಏನು, ಪಹಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಬರೆದಿದೆಯಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಆ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಜಾಗ ತಮ್ಮದು ಅಂತ ಪಕ್ಕದವರು ವಾದ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
where_to_verify: Karnataka Land Revenue Act (1964) ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ TBD-boundary ರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಠ್ಯವನ್ನು ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ (indiacode.nic.in) ಓದಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಉಚಿತ ಕಾನೂನು ನೆರವಿಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾನೂನು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆ ಅಲ್ಲ.

what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: पड़ोसी के साथ दो ज़मीनों की सीमा कहाँ है इस पर विवाद, जो आमतौर पर सरकारी सर्वे से सुलझता है।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: मेरी ज़मीन का सर्वे नंबर 36/3 है और रिकॉर्ड में रकबा साफ़ लिखा है। पिछले साल उन्होंने सीमा के पत्थर उखाड़कर मेरी तरफ़ लगा दिए।
conditions: क्या सीमा के पत्थर या बाड़ हटाई गई? किसने और कब? — आपने हाँ कहा
आपकी ज़मीन का सर्वे नंबर क्या है, और क्या आरटीसी में रकबा लिखा है? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या आपका पड़ोसी उस पट्टी ज़मीन को अपनी बताता है? — अभी पता नहीं
where_to_verify: Karnataka Land Revenue Act (1964) की धारा TBD-boundary का आधिकारिक पाठ इंडिया कोड (indiacode.nic.in) पर पढ़ें, या मुफ़्त कानूनी सहायता के लिए ज़िला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण से संपर्क करें। यह कानूनी सलाह नहीं है।

what_it_says:
Any person entitled to any legal 
character, or to any right as to any property, may institute a suit against any person denying, or interested 
to deny, his title to such character or right, and the court may in its discretion make therein a declaration 
that he is so entitled, and the plaintiff need not in such suit ask for any further relief: 
Provided that no court shall make any such declaration where the plaintiff, being able to seek further 
relief than a mere declaration of title, omits to do so.

why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2024 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಲ್ಪಾ ಗಡಿ ಕಲ್ಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಿತ್ತು ನನ್ನ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಹಾಕಿದರು. ನನ್ನ ಜಮೀನು ಸರ್ವೇ ನಂಬರ್ 177/1, ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿದೆ.
conditions: ಗಡಿ ಕಲ್ಲು ಅಥವಾ ಬೇಲಿ ಸರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆಯಾ? ಯಾರು, ಯಾವಾಗ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

ಆ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಜಾಗ ತಮ್ಮದು ಅಂತ ಪಕ್ಕದವರು ವಾದ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does 
thereby cause hurt to any person, is said “voluntarily to cause hurt”. 
(2) Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub -section ( 1) of section 122 voluntarily causes 
hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, 
or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.

(1) Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing 
hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does 
thereby cause hurt to any person, is said “voluntarily to cause hurt”. 
(2) Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub -section ( 1) of section 122 voluntarily causes 
hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, 
or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.

conditions: ಯಾವ ದಾಖಲೆ ನಕಲಿ ಅಂತ ನಿಮಗೆ ಅನ್ಸುತ್ತೆ — ವಿಲ್, ಸೇಲ್ ಡೀಡ್, ದಾನಪತ್ರ? ಯಾರು ಮಾಡಿದ್ದು? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

what_it_says:
Whoever forges a document which purports to be a 
valuable security or a will, or an authority to adopt a son, or which purports to give authority to any 
person to make or transfer any valuable security, or to receive the principal, interest or dividends thereon, 
or to receive or deliver any money, movable property, or valuable security, or any document purporting 
to be an acquittance or receipt acknowledging the payment of money, or an acquittance or receipt for the 
delivery of any movable property or valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or 
with imprisonment …
what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: किसी ने वसीयत या सेल डीड जैसा जाली दस्तावेज़ बनाकर उसे असली बताकर संपत्ति पर दावा किया।

conditions: आपको कौन सा दस्तावेज़ जाली लगता है — वसीयत, सेल डीड, दानपत्र? किसने बनाया? — अभी पता नहीं
क्या उस दस्तावेज़ पर दस्तख़त या अँगूठे का निशान असली है? — आपने हाँ कहा

what_it_says:
(1) A false document or 
electronic record made wholly or in part by forgery is designated a forged document or electronic record. 
(2) Whoever fraudulently or dishonestly uses as genuine any document or electronic record which he 
knows or has reason to believe to be a forged document or electronic record, shall be punished in the 
same manner as if he had forged such document or electronic record.

person to make or transfer any valuable security, or to receive the principal, interest or dividends thereon,

electronic record made wholly or in part by forgery is designated a forged document or electronic record. 
(2) Whoever fraudulently or dishonestly uses as genuine any document or electronic record which he
